input.quote: At the written request of Customer, given at least 100 days prior to expiration of the Term of the Agreement, M&I shall continue to provide Customer all Services at the rates set forth in this Agreement, for a maximum period of six (6) months.
input.rationale: Section 11.4 (p0192) supplies Termination Assistance on expiry or any termination for any reason and confirms charging at M&I's then-current rates, but it fails the fallback on two material terms. First, the only quantified assistance period (six months of continued Services) is conditioned on a written request given at least 100 days before expiration of the Term, so it is unavailable after a mid-term termination; a pre-expiry request condition does not establish a post-termination assistance duration. Second, nothing in the Agreement obliges M&I to return or export Customer Data: Section 17.1 (p0243) confirms Customer ownership and 17.5 (p0250) only addresses safeguards, and there is no return, export, or delivery obligation anywhere. We therefore insert a fallback-level clause giving at least 90 days of Termination Assistance after any expiry or termination and a 30-day Customer Data export, leaving the existing six-month expiry mechanic and then-current-rates basis untouched.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
mappings.quote: Commencing six (6) months prior to the expiration of the Term of this Agreement, or upon any termination of this Agreement for any reason, M&I shall provide Customer, at Customer's expense, all necessary assistance

mappings.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.

proposal.summary: Insert 90-day post-termination Termination Assistance period and 30-day Customer Data export obligation
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.4 conditions the continued-service period on a request made 100 days before expiry and says nothing about returning our data, so we added a minimum ninety (90) day Termination Assistance period following any expiry or termination and a thirty (30) day Customer Data export obligation. This is our fallback exit position.

ops.text: 11.5 Transition Period; Data Export. Termination Assistance shall be available to Customer for at least ninety (90) days following the expiration or any termination of this Agreement, and M&I shall export and deliver to Customer all Customer Data then in M&I's possession within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination.
